newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SWIMMING-SANCHEZ RETAINS MEN'S 50 FREESTYLE WORLD TITLE.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-SANCHEZ RETAINS MEN'S 50 FREESTYLE WORLD TITLE.

text.p: Venezuela's Francisco Sanchez won his duel with former champion Mark Foster to retain his 50 metres freestyle title and complete a golden double at the world short-course swimming championships on Sunday.
Sanchez, who won the 100 freestyle on Saturday, edged clear of Britain's Foster on the return length in the 25-metre Scandinavium indoor arena pool.
Sanchez touched in 21.80 seconds to match the championship record he set in winning the event at the last world short-course championships in Rio de Janeiro in December 1995.
Foster, gold medallist at the inaugural championships in Palma de Mallorca in 1993, took the silver in 22.03, slower than the 21.95 he clocked in the heats as fastest qualifier for the final.
Ricardo Busquets of Puerto Rico took the bronze in 22.17.
